verdict.rationale: 1Password documents several programmatic surfaces. The Connect Server offers a REST API for items and vaults with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.2 spec, and the Events API ships a semver'd OpenAPI spec with an interactive "Try it" playground and documented V1/V2 versioning. Official SDKs in Go, JavaScript and Python also support programmatic item management. Missing for 10: the item-management REST API requires deploying a self-hosted Connect Server rather than calling a hosted public endpoint; there is no account-wide or Connect-API deprecation policy; the Service Accounts/CLI/SDK surfaces have no API specs; and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the REST APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: 1Password Connect Servers allow you to securely access your 1Password items and vaults in your company's apps and cloud infrastructure using a private REST API.
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file.
1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1)
The Events API and Connect API references run the Mintlify interactive playground
1Password SDKs allow you to build integrations that programmatically interact with 1Password using Go, JavaScript, or Python.
